use_case: Use the estimate worksheet during residential plumbing service call dispatch when the plumbing call record must identify fixture or piping, leak location, shutoff access, water availability, affected rooms, occupancy, and prior repair. Complete the applicable handoff for leak-free test, restored fixtures, customer instructions, damage referral, permit follow-up, and service warranty.
